title: Series file
description: One time-series: identity header, current observations, an append-only revision log, and break metadata. See docs/DATA-CONTRACT.md sections 3-4. Panels use panel.schema.json instead.

id.description: agency-slug[-qualifier], lowercase kebab, ASCII. Equals the filename stem. Immutable once published.

name_zh.description: Chinese display name; DATA-CONTRACT section 12 typesetting.

value_type.description: What m/ytd MEAN; drives rendering. See DATA-CONTRACT section 3.3.

freq.description: Default frequency; a per-observation freq may override on a switch.

calibers.description: Which measure lanes this series populates.

rule.description: e.g. single_from_ytd, ratio, simple_mean_of_cities, count_cities_gt_zero, sum.

inputs.description: series/panel ids this value is computed from.

derived.description: null for primary series; object for build-time derived values (DATA-CONTRACT section 6).

observations.description: Current best values, ascending by period, one per period.

revisions.description: Append-only change log; ascending by (period, measure).

end.description: Set when the series is frozen (e.g. superseded by a new id after a break).

period.description: YYYY-MM (monthly), YYYY-Qn (quarterly), or YYYY (annual). Jan-Feb combined uses the end month YYYY-02 with span:2.

freq.description: Present only when it differs from the series default.

span.description: # of base periods the single-period value aggregates. Jan-Feb combined = 2. Absent => 1.

m.description: Single-period (当月/单季/单期) headline in the unit value_type declares. For mom_pct this is the 环比 %.

m_yoy.description: Published YoY (同比) alongside m. VERBATIM — never computed from levels.

ytd.description: Cumulative-to-date (累计) value, same unit as m.

ytd_yoy.description: Published YoY on the cumulative caliber. VERBATIM.

mom.description: Published 环比 % as an EXTRA measure beyond m (e.g. CPI). Unused when m is already a MoM %.

src.description: Provenance pointer: archive release-id this value came from.

revised_on.description: Date the revising release published (YYYY-MM-DD). null for legacy-seeded entries of unknown date.

no_yoy_across.description: Hard instruction: no YoY may span this seam. Build inserts null at the seam.

supersedes.description: Old series id this one replaces (new-id breaks).

superseded_by.description: New series id that replaces this one.
